description: A close view of a great dragon's head and long arched neck, seen from the party's eye level and facing left. Its scales are bronze and brown with pink edges, a row of tall yellow-tipped spines runs along the head and neck, and its underside is banded in pale yellow. It has a green eye, a long snout and jaws lined with white fangs. The neck curves back in a great hoop, and a spined ridge of its body or wing crosses the lower left corner. Behind it is a deep blue night sky above black mountain silhouettes. The colors glow warm against the cold dark, and the mood is fierce and imposing. Frame 1: the head is lowered and thrust forward with jaws parted; held for a long moment. Frame 2: the head jerks back and up a little, very briefly. Frame 3: the head rears higher with the jaws gaping wide, held a short while. The loop reads as a long menacing glare, then a quick snap and roar.
title: Bronze dragon rearing its head
